headline: A 2001 order sets who would run the Department of Agriculture if its top leaders could not do the job.
what_it_does: This executive order sets an order of succession for the U.S. Department of Agriculture. That means it lists which officials would take over the duties of the Secretary of Agriculture if the Secretary and other top leaders died, resigned, or could not serve. No official summary was provided, so details such as the exact list of officials are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: Senior officials at the Department of Agriculture
who_it_affects.how: They may be called on to act as head of the department, in a set order, if higher-ranking leaders cannot serve.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed December 18, 2001; the title does not state a separate start date.
